description: This PHP source file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class 'PerformanceReviewSearchFilterParams' used for filtering performance review search results in the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base filter parameters class and includes properties for various filtering criteria such as employee number, reviewer number, job title, subunit, status, date range, and inclusion options. The class also defines constant arrays for allowed sort fields and statuses, and provides getter and setter methods for its properties.

classes.name: PerformanceReviewSearchFilterParams
